data.explanation: Fact A identifies the date the fresh certificate of incorporation was issued by the RoC, while Fact B identifies the date the shareholders passed the resolution to amend the Memorandum of Association. Both are distinct legal milestones in the process of changing a company name.
data.reconciliation: The name change process involves both a shareholder resolution (September 29, 2021) and the subsequent issuance of a fresh certificate of incorporation by the Registrar of Companies (October 12, 2021).
